children: El Salvador President Nayib Bukele accused El País of publishing false news after the newspaper reported that the country had transferred majority ownership and control of more than 7,763 bitcoin to a private operator. According to Odaily, Bukele said the claim was completely false and that the International Monetary Fund statement cited by El País referred to a transfer of Chivo wallet shares, not El Salvador's strategic bitcoin reserve. He also accused the media outlet of lying to readers.

title: El Salvador's Bukele Denies Report on Bitcoin Reserve Transfer
